title: bupleurum odontites var. nanum
intro: Bupleurum odontites var. nanum, commonly known as dwarf hare's ear, is a small, perennial plant belonging to the family Apiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum odontites var. nanum include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
